named_events.loss_description: For the 2023 underwriting year of Syndicate 1856, there is currently no net material exposure to the IsraelGaza Conflict. This has not been reserved for separately, as it is believed this is adequately reserved for in general IBNR.
The underwriting stance on property reinsurance led to strong performance despite insured Nat Cat losses in 2023 exceeding $100 billion.

data.standardized_narrative: Prior year reserve development for Syndicate 1856 at 31 Dec 2023 was effectively flat (no material gross prior-year strengthening or release). The gross claims development triangle shows no aggregate movement on underwriting years up to and including 2021. The Managing Agent explicitly considered economic and excess inflation in reserving (uplifts to outstanding claims and IBNR / IELRs) and set a management margin; the Syndicate also notes exposure to large natural catastrophes in 2023 and comments that there is currently no net material exposure to the IsraelGaza conflict.
raw_causal_phrases: Economic Uncertainty Risk including Inflation Risk
We have explicitly considered economic and excess inflation in the reserving process when setting the best estimate reserves

Uplifting outstanding claims reserves by a set factor (at class of business underwriting year level). This factor was derived by weighting calendar year inflation assumptions with the expected proportion of future claims to be paid in each calendar year.
For IBNR claims the Managing Agent has uplifted the initial expected loss ratios ("IELRs") used in the reserving model.
The underwriting stance on property reinsurance led to strong performance despite insured Nat Cat losses in 2023 exceeding $100 billion.
For the 2023 underwriting year of Syndicate 1856, there is currently no net material exposure to the IsraelGaza Conflict.
The booked ultimates for these losses as at 31 December 2023 are GBP 51.7 million gross of reinsurance and GBP 21.3 million net of reinsurance (inclusive of inwards and outwards RIPs).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and Other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (Analysis of claims development - gross of reinsurance). No explicit gross 'movement in prior years' reconciliation note was found; the triangle shows no aggregate movement for underwriting years up to 2021 (current estimates equal prior diagonal estimates), so prior_year_development_gbp_m set to 0.0. No verbatim sentence describing prior-year reserve movement was located. Per-LOB prior-year movements are not quantified in the report and thus are null. All monetary values are taken from the report's UK pound sterling presentational figures.
